ko.title: 천문학자들, 토성 대기에서 10각형 구조 발견
ko.hook: 토성의 знамени한 육각형 구조 외에 대기 파동으로 형성된 새로운 10각형 패턴 포착

en.title: Astronomers Detect a 10-Sided Structure in Saturn's Atmosphere
en.hook: A new decagonal atmospheric pattern detected in Saturn's atmosphere beyond its famous hexagon
key_takeaways: Discovery of a unique 10-sided wave structure in Saturn's atmosphere
Provides fresh insights for planetary fluid dynamics and atmospheric instability modeling
Demonstrates the power of continued astronomical observational analysis

zh.title: 天文学家在土星大气中发现十边形结构
zh.hook: 继著名的土星六边形之后，天文学家在大气层中观察到全新的十边形结构
key_takeaways: 在土星大气中探测到独特的十边形波动图案
为行星流体力学和大气不稳定性研究带来新课题
体现了高分辨率天文观测与行星建模的重要突破
